findings.reason: The protected recursive delta propagation is output-correct but revisits a reconverging formula once per dependency path. A legal 12-layer diamond contains only 25 distinct cells yet causes 8,216 propagation calls, and deeper legal diamonds grow exponentially. This violates the Optimal branch's O(N + F) update bound, so the defect is material rather than stylistic.

The inert candidate preserves formula Counters and reverse dependency edges, collects each distinct affected descendant, and topologically recomputes every affected formula exactly once after all changed predecessors are current. The design is conventional, cohesive, and interview-ready; its names expose affected cells, indegrees, ready work, sources, targets, dependencies, and multiplicities without unnecessary abstraction.

Each formula expands individual cells and inclusive ranges into exact multiplicities. Replacing a target removes only its obsolete incoming formula edges, while downstream formulas remain attached. The candidate recomputes a changed formula from current sources, discovers every downstream dependent through reverse edges, and processes the induced acyclic subgraph in topological order. Every formula is therefore evaluated after all affected predecessors and exactly reflects duplicate, overlapping, direct, transitive, positive, and negative contributions.
